title: When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment.
paragraphs: When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment.

The morning air is thin as we climb…
Every step up Mount Moriah feels heavier than the last.

Abraham walks ahead, steady… determined.
Isaac carries the wood.
No one speaks for a long while.

The path is quiet, but the weight of trust fills the silence.
Because obedience sometimes asks for everything.
I imagine standing there on that narrow trail… watching a man continue upward even when the cost seems unbearable.
And somehow, this moment whispers a truth that echoes through every generation:

Faith isn’t always loud or dramatic…
Sometimes it’s simply the courage to keep walking when you don’t understand the road ahead.
And as the mountain rises before us, I find myself asking:
Would my trust climb this high?
